title: ascm Markdown frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of every Markdown file in the ascm repository except the reserved index.md and log.md files. It follows OKF v0.2 and records authorship with the same fields the Generated-by and Assisted-by commit trailers carry.
$comment: The generated entries mirror the Generated-by and Assisted-by commit trailer grammar (Key: LLM attr=value;...), documented in docs/reference/frontmatter.md. The same field names, value formats, and hashed-ID form apply, and, as in a trailer, a field that cannot be determined is omitted and never guessed or defaulted.

type.description: What kind of document this is. A closed set: add a value here, in the same change as the first document that needs it.

title.description: Human-readable title. It matches the level-one heading and the title of the file's index entry.

description.description: One sentence saying what the document covers. It is reused as the description of the file's index entry.

tags.description: Lowercase kebab-case keywords, unique within the document.

status.description: Lifecycle state: draft for work in progress, stable for current content, deprecated for retired content.

generated.description: Who or what wrote the document, one entry per contributor. Agents fill it from their own identity. Omit it for a document no agent touched.

verified.description: Added by a human only, after reading the document and finding it correct. An agent never writes this field.

contributor.description: One agent contribution. The fields are the attributes of a Generated-by or Assisted-by trailer, except that role is the trailer key and at is added because a document has no commit date.

role.description: The trailer key: generated for Generated-by (the agent wrote content), assisted for Assisted-by (the agent took part without writing content).

harness.description: Harness slug with an optional version after a colon, as in claude-code:2.1.316. Slugs: claude-code, codex, antigravity.

model.description: The creator's canonical API model ID with its provider, as <provider>:<model-id>. Providers are OpenTelemetry gen_ai.provider.name values: anthropic, openai, gcp.gemini. No effort suffix.

effort.description: Reasoning effort exactly as the harness reported it, lowercased, such as low, high, or max. Never mapped across vendors.

surface.description: Raw passthrough of the harness surface, such as cli or claude-vscode. No whitespace, semicolons, or commas.

session.description: The root session as an unkeyed SHA-256 hash of its raw ID, leftmost 64 bits as 16 lowercase hex digits. A raw ID is never written.

subagent.description: The subagent that did the work, in the same hashed form as session. Omitted for the root agent.

at.description: When the contribution was made: a UTC ISO 8601 date-time with whole seconds and a Z suffix.

verified.description: A human's sign-off on the document.

by.description: The verifying person as human:<name>, where the name is lowercase. The human: prefix keeps this field apart from agent identities.

at.description: When the person verified the document.

hashedId.description: sha-256-64:<16 lowercase hex digits>, the IANA Named Information label for an unkeyed SHA-256 truncated to 64 bits.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 date-time, whole seconds, Z suffix.
